subject: general
question: A car covers four successive 3 km stretches at speeds of 10 km/h, 20 km/h, 30 km/h and 60 km/h, respectively. Its average speed over this distance is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Since the distance for each of the 4 stretches is **equal** (3 km), the **Average Speed** is the **Harmonic Mean** of the speeds.

Average Speed = 4 ÷ (1/10 + 1/20 + 1/30 + 1/60)

Average Speed = 4 ÷ [(6 + 3 + 2 + 1) / 60] = 4 ÷ (12 / 60)

Average Speed = 4 × 5 = 20 km/h

**∴ The correct answer is 20 km/h.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Four stretches of distance (d) = 3 km each.

Speeds (v₁, v₂, v₃, v₄) = 10 km/h, 20 km/h, 30 km/h, and 60 km/h.

**Formula Used:**

**Average Speed = Total Distance ÷ Total Time**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d5daef23c83e6cf0776cca8d927e3571921ee7ce8dda728ae5f7245b1368bdf7.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total Distance = 3 + 3 + 3 + 3 = 12 km

⇒ Time for 1st stretch (t₁) = 3 ÷ 10 = 0.3 h

⇒ Time for 2ⁿd stretch (t₂) = 3 ÷ 20 = 0.15 h

⇒ Time for 3rd stretch (t₃) = 3 ÷ 30 = 0.1 h

⇒ Time for 4th stretch (t₄) = 3 ÷ 60 = 0.05 h

⇒ Total Time = 0.3 + 0.15 + 0.1 + 0.05 = 0.6 h

⇒ Average Speed = 12 ÷ 0.6 = 20 km/h

**∴ The correct answer is 20 km/h.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Average Speed for Two Equal Distances

If a journey is divided into two equal distances with speeds v₁ and v₂, the average speed is 2v₁v₂ ÷ (v₁ + v₂).

Average Speed for Equal Time Intervals

If a body travels at speed v₁ for time t and then at speed v₂ for the same time t, the average speed is (v₁ + v₂) ÷ 2.

Unit Conversion

To convert speed from km/h to m/s, multiply the value by 5/18. To convert m/s to km/h, multiply by 18/5.</p
